notes:
Summary: latency- and cost-sensitive trading/alerts agent. Real-time personalization + alerting in client dashboards. Strong cost pressure (per-token budget) and tight latency SLOs. Key asks: 1) deterministic perf numbers for 128/256 token chat path, 2) guidance on batching vs single-request latency tradeoffs, 3) quantization impact on tail-latency and quality (int8/ptq vs fp16), 4) caching strategy for repeated prefixes (KV cache and prefix caching).

Recent quote from Head of ML: "If p95 jumps >50ms we lose customers — need predictable degradation and cheap backups."

Security: needs SSO + audit logging + customer-managed KMS. Data residency for EU customers (some accounts). POC requirements: VPC endpoint, isolated GPU pool, logs shipped to their SIEM.

Key perf targets (customer-specified): p50 < 35ms, p95 < 90ms for 128 token chat under 200 concurrent sessions; 200 QPS reranking job with 100ms p95. Cost target: reduce per-req token compute cost by 30% vs current managed provider.

Requests to Redwood: run controlled benchmark comparing: a) hosted fp16 baseline, b) dedicated with int8 quantization, c) dedicated with batching at 8/16 and KV cache enabled. Provide trace-level latency breakdown (model compute, kernel wait, queuing, network). Include recommendation for autoscale headroom and fallback to cheaper model variant.

AE notes/shorthand: POC budget approved at exec level but needs final procurement. SE to push perf script and sample dataset. Ask: can Redwood supply a canned benchmark harness or should we mirror?
